async function save(x) {}

// CASE js_regex_quote_after_await expect=pass
async function clean(names) {
  for (let i = 0, n = names.length; i < n; i++) {
    names[i] = names[i].replace(/'/g, "");
  }
  await save(names);
  return 'done';
}

// CASE js_regex_brace_after_await expect=pass
async function braces(rows) {
  for (let i = 0, n = rows.length; i < n; i++) {
    rows[i] = rows[i].replace(/[{]/g, "(");
  }
  await save(rows);
}

// CASE js_division_comment_after expect=pass
async function ratio(rows) {
  let total = 0;
  for (let i = 0, n = rows.length; i < n; i++) total += rows[i] / 2;
  await save(total);
}

// CASE js_end expect=pass
function end() {}
